findings: Exact domestic full SKU and module configuration resolved for G.SKILL F4-3200C16D-16GVKB at two primary sellers, but both currently sold out; their displayed prices were not adopted.

Five model-reference retail price candidates are separated from existing identities. Four are proposed for implementation previews; ASRock B850M Pro RS remains outside that initial scope pending radio/package context.
Unsupported price providers and Danawa mini-shop link layouts are collection-path limitations, not evidence of market stock absence.
A live DB voltage conflict previously claimed for CMK32GX5M2E6000C36 was a report classification error: original upstream payload is 1.4V but running DB and official selected SKU both show1.35V.
Missing RAM PN, monitor region suffixes, GPU board/revision/package differences and conflicting seller stock data were not filled from similar product prices.
limitations: Public source research was bounded and did not exhaust all domestic sellers. A NO_CURRENT_QUOTE decision describes reviewed pages, not national unavailability or manufacturer discontinuation.
Computer Use ended because current browser URL on Windows could not be determined confidently. Image-only seller PN evidence remains unverified; no bypass or media-download workaround was attempted.
All observed candidate prices remain unapproved. This report contains zero price rows to publish; price availability did not increase merely from collecting family-price candidates.
No new backend run configuration is needed for the completed research. Actual catalog application and central price publication require separate approval.
